SATA publishes checks for token authority, Raydium liquidity, LP lock status, and the BTC reserve. Reserve transparency is not a redemption promise or guaranteed price floor. Owner-held unlocked LP is disclosed.

https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/transparency

SATA has a dedicated Bitcoin reserve address with signed address-control proof. Current first tranche: 500,000 sats.

The BTC reserve is not a redemption promise or guaranteed price floor.

https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/transparency

SATA mint and freeze authorities are revoked on Solana mainnet. That means no hidden minting path and no freeze authority when the public checks are passing.

Verify from the public report:
https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/transparency

The Raydium SATA/WSOL pool is live. Initial Burn & Earn LP lock is verified, and owner-held unlocked LP is disclosed separately.

Unlocked LP remains removable unless separately locked and verified.

https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/transparency

Long-term SATA treasury target: 10 BTC.

The point is to move attention toward sats, custody, reserves, and proof over time. This is not a redemption path, price target, or market-support promise.

Proof over promises.

SATA offers $50 transparency audits: authority, liquidity-lock, BTC reserve, and disclosure checks.

The BTC reserve is not a redemption promise or guaranteed price floor. Locked status must be verified.

https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/services/transparency-audit

SATA service path: $50 transparency audit first. If a team wants implementation help, scope can move to a $150 report setup or $300 proof dashboard.

No market outcome, volume, or buyer-demand claims.

https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/services/transparency-audit

SATA referral partners are post-receipt only: real transparency-service customer referrals, no upfront payment, no buyer/price claims, no fake engagement. Compensation requires confirmed receipt and chairman approval. https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/partners/referrals

SATA published a sample $50 transparency audit: authority, liquidity, reserve, and disclosure checks.

Not a redemption promise or guaranteed price floor. Locked LP verified; unlocked LP disclosed separately.

https://sata-project-reserve.github.io/sata/services/sample-audit

GMGN route status will be claimed only after current buy and sell routes are manually verified from the public interface.

Until then, use the transparency report as source of truth. Unlocked LP remains removable unless separately locked and verified.
